text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Furioso had suffered a serious 
injury, I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.
choice_data_list: Are you okay!? If it hurts, lie down...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
No, an injury of this degree won't... I 
have my next race coming up, so... I have 
to hurry.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Kh!
choice_data_list:
...Do you realize you're pushing yourself 
too hard?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, last night, a package of 
vegetables arrived from my parents."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I ate vegetables from Funabashi for the 
first time in a while. They were so sweet 
and delicious."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My heart feels so warm and cozy. It 
brought back so many memories of the past, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
To give it my all for Funabashi, for 
everyone. From the bottom of my heart, I 
truly wanted to win.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. I know I'm pushing myself. 
But right now, I really want to do my 
best."
choice_data_list: Getting better quickly is the top priority

Getting better quickly is the top 
priority, okay?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. I know I'm pushing myself. 
But right now, I really want to do my 
best."
choice_data_list: Getting better quickly is the top priority

Getting better quickly is the top 
priority, okay?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: However...!
choice_data_list:
No one wants to see you pushing yourself 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
... ...I cannot allow myself to make 
everyone worry.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
In that case, at the very least! I'll cure 
you in no time.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Once I have recovered, I look forward to 
your training guidance once more.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Why... why do I feel pain...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to impatience, the injury worsened. 
More time would have to be dedicated to 
treatment.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Don't rush... Don't rush.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...All right! Looking good!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Funabashi is over that way.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone—I will win, no matter what. I'll 
prove that we can stand up to the Chuoh."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Recovering steadily, Furioso's passion 
for Funabashi burned brightly once more."
